column1: # ZAP baseline rules (ADR 0034). Unlisted rules warn; these fail the build or are accepted with a reason.

column3: (Non-Storable Content: pages are per user and must not be cached)
(CSP style-src unsafe-inline: React sets inline style attributes; scripts are nonce-only)
(COEP not set: no cross-origin isolation features used; COOP and CORP are set)
(HSTS: the local stack is plain HTTP; Caddy sets HSTS in staging and production)
(Cookie without Secure flag: local HTTP only; secure cookies in staging and production)
(Anti-CSRF tokens in forms: forms are sent by script with the X-XSRF-TOKEN header; a plain POST to a page changes nothing)
